title: GitHub control plane: main is PR-only; Issue -> WP -> PR traceability
objective: Make main the accepted integration ledger: active ruleset with zero bypass, squash-only, BADF-MAIN-001 as doctrine, PR traceability check in CI.
business_value: Before this, main was not PR-only (protection held by accident of which events a status check reported on) and the repository had never had an Issue. The control plane must be structurally correct before autonomous execution authority increases.
acceptance_criteria: git push origin main is refused citing the pull_request rule
squash is the only allowed merge method in the ruleset
a PR without Work-Package + Closes fails the traceability step
PR #20 merges as one linear squash commit and auto-closes #19

rollback.method: delete ruleset 21658781; restore repo merge settings; revert 12f5056 via PR

note: This record was written AFTER the WP landed (BADF-WP-0018), because WP-0016 adopted the 'no WP without a demand record' doctrine without having a work-package record of its own. Its demand, Issue #19, was real and preceded the work; only this file is late.
